name: Limit Switch
spec: Inductive sensor M8x1, PNP, normally closed, 2 mm flush, 10-30 V DC, built-in M8 3-pin plug
notes: One limit switch at each end of travel. Mass not yet checked against the datasheet.

name: Limit Switch Cable
spec: M8 3-pin A-coded socket, straight, to open ends, 2 m, PVC, rated for drag chains
notes: One cable per limit switch. Mass not yet checked against the datasheet.

name: End Stop Damper
spec: stroke 7 mm; length 16 mm; body 17 mm; impact face 15 mm; 22 mm when fully compressed; M4 stud 4 mm long; 1.7 Nm max; 6 Nm per stroke (9 Nm emergency stop)
notes: One damper at each corner of the carriage ends. Each is held by an M4 square nut in a slot in carriage-bottom.

name: Linear Encoder Read Head
spec: RSF AK MC 15 B absolute scanning head, BiSS C, 0.1 um step, 36 x 13.5 x 14.8 mm, 0.5 m cable, 15-pin D-sub; air gap 0.55 +-0.25 mm; 2 x M3 thread 26 mm apart, max 1.2 Nm
notes: On carriage-bottom with two M3 x 16 screws. Set the gap with the 0.55 mm gap foil that comes with the head. Ask RSF for the ID number of the 0.5 m cable before ordering.

name: Linear Encoder Scale
spec: RSF MC 15 MK absolute steel tape scale, 240 mm measuring length, 260 mm long, tape 8 x 0.25 mm on adhesive tape 6 x 0.2 mm, +-15 um/m
notes: Stuck on the inside of the side wall of the base with the TMT Mx 15 MK mounting tool. No end clamps.

name: Roller Bearing
spec: Flanged ball bearing 2 x 6 x 3 mm, flange 7.5 x 0.8 mm, shields on both sides (ZZ)
notes: Two in each of the eight seal strip rollers. The flange rests on the end of the roller sleeve. Order the shielded F692ZZ: the open F692 is narrower. NSK gives no mass.

name: Roller Axle
spec: Parallel pin ISO 8734, hardened steel, type A, 2 mm (m6) x 28 mm
notes: The fixed axle of each seal strip roller. Two countersunk screws clamp it against the wall and the floor of the axle slot.

name: Roller Washer
spec: Plain washer ISO 7092, size 2 (for M2), 2.2 x 4.5 x 0.3 mm, 200 HV, A2 stainless steel
notes: Two in each seal strip roller, between the inner ring of each bearing and the pocket wall.

name: Strip Preload Screw
spec: Hexagon socket countersunk head screw ISO 10642, M4 x 10, A2 stainless steel
notes: Fitting tool. One at each end of the seal strip. Its cone pushes the outer edge of the strip hole and so sets the pull. Taken out after the corner screws are tight. Mass not yet checked.

name: Strip Corner Screw
spec: Hexagon socket button head screw with collar ISO 7380-2, M4 x 10, A2 stainless steel
notes: One at each corner of the seal strip. Clamps the strip ear on the base after the pull is set. Mass not yet checked.

name: Magnet Strip Long
spec: Neodymium magnet tape, self-adhesive, 3 x 0.5 mm, cut to 417.5 mm
notes: One on each long side of the magnet ring in the base, adhesive face down on the ring floor. It holds the seal strip flat. Cut from the roll 3X0.5X500: order 3 rolls per base (one roll gives one long and three short pieces, the third roll two short pieces). The seller gives no mass.

name: Magnet Strip Short
spec: Neodymium magnet tape, self-adhesive, 3 x 0.5 mm, cut to 21.5 mm
notes: Four in each end leg of the magnet ring, one on each piece of solid floor between a corner cavity, a damper slot and the split at the preload screw. Adhesive face down. Cut from the roll 3X0.5X500 (see MEC-007). The seller gives no mass.

name: Cooling Port O-Ring
notes: Face seal at each of the two ports, in a groove in the bottom of the printed cooling block.

name: Forcer Cooling O-Ring
notes: Seals the cooling channel over the forcer, in the groove in the forcer pocket ceiling of carriage-bottom. Not drawn in the assembly: in the groove it takes a rounded rectangle shape, which a round model cannot show.

name: Cooling Fitting
spec: Festo push-in fitting NPQH-D-M5-Q4-P10 (578334), male thread M5, for 4 mm tubing, nickel-plated brass, water up to 0.6 MPa at 0-50 C
notes: Screwed into the M5 threads tapped in the head of the cooling block, 1 Nm. Sold in packs of 10.

name: Cooling Hose
spec: Festo tubing PUN-H-4X0,75-BL (197383), polyurethane, 4 x 2.6 mm, blue
notes: Order one piece of 2 m and cut both hoses from it. The assembly shows a 20 mm stub at each fitting.

name: Cooling Block Screw Short
spec: Hexagon socket countersunk head screw ISO 10642, M2.5 x 6, A2 stainless steel
notes: From below, through the 2.5 mm floor of the cooling block pocket, into the wide part of the block. Mass not yet checked.

name: Cooling Block Screw Long
spec: Hexagon socket countersunk head screw ISO 10642, M2.5 x 8, A2 stainless steel
notes: From below, near the side face, into the arm of the block. 2.3 mm of thread in the resin. Mass not yet checked.
